title: Services email and Space page: eleven email types and the Space face
detail: Plan step 7b: eleven email templates (confirm, reminder, welcome, review, receipt, post, event, order, member, letter, inquiry) following register, accent, type voice and corners; Space page follows fonts, accent and register while synced inside Frequency's own frame (only the Space area wears the kit). 2026-11-02: the email half is built as lib/theme/services-kit-email.ts (servicesKitEmail, eleven types, tested), built against New World / Services revision 2 (Unbounded, Instrument Serif, Hanken Grotesk; accent steps are passed in already resolved per register, so the revision 2 hue maths stays in the theme); nothing is wired to the catalog yet. Still open: the Space page faces and default accent in lib/theme/site-style.ts, which the probe checks and which moves to the theme-registration row (LIVE-2040); lib/email-samples/catalog.ts wiring rides with it.
